summary: Strike-only for Floralaine at the Cooper Hewitt: ~46 work units of glass-heavy tablescapes plus ceremony/tent-entrance meadows with all mechanics kept. Slow-strike job (≈3 units/person-hour). Recommend a team of 5, starting 10:30pm, off property by ~2:00am, Glen Ridge offload included.

zones.name: Reception tables
zones.tasks: 13 rounds (arrangement, 3 tapers + sleeves, 3 votives) + 8 rectangles (2 medium + 2 petite arrangements, 4 pillars, 4–6 votives)
zones.notes: ~25 units; candles + glass are the slow part

zones.name: Ceremony pieces at band + tent entrance
zones.tasks: 10 aisle meadows + semi-circle meadow (repurposed in front of band), layered ceramic pots, 2 metal arch stands, 4 pillar lanterns
zones.notes: Keep ALL mechanics and moss/chicken wire; pots are heavy

zones.name: Bars, cocktail + after party
zones.tasks: 2 reception bars, cocktail bar + lounge, 10 bud vases + 10 votives, after-party 15 bud vases + bar (collect at midnight)
zones.notes: Shared by whoever finishes tables first

zones.name: Truck pack + studio offload
zones.tasks: Pack labeled boxes per Taylor's videos, strap, drive to Glen Ridge, offload to driveway/patio, trash in driveway

logistics_notes: Montclair HQ is closest (Glen Ridge studio is ~10 min from HQ).
Two vehicles: crew in the JS van, one driver brings Floralaine's truck back. Truck is street-parked near the museum: get the exact spot + key contact before 10pm.
Garden entrance on 90th St between Madison + 5th: pull the truck up there to load.
Hard out 2:00am; this plan is off property ~12:45am with a 75-min buffer.
No trash at the venue: all trash rides back to Taylor's driveway.
reasoning: ~46 work units at the SLOW strike speed (3/ph: glass-heavy, keep all mechanics, labeled packing, lawn tent → street truck in NYC) ≈ 15.3 person-hours + 1.5 for kept mechanics ≈ 17 person-hours on site.
Window 10:30pm → 2:00am hard out (3.25 hrs after prep) → 5 people. With 4 people it runs past the hard out (this is what happened on 10/24: done ~3:30am without unloading).
Glen Ridge offload planned as its own 40-min step.
red_flags: Hard out 2:00am is tight: if the venue won't let us start until 11pm, go to 6 people.
Truck location TBD on the street; late key handoff eats strike time.
Candle hard goods changed (p.12) and the floor plan grew to 13 rounds + 8 rectangles.
